T: Bangarang. Dinner's imaginary. Not this one.
D: A grown-up Peter Pan returns to Neverland to rescue his children from Captain Hook.
P: Serve the mains when Peter finally imagines the Lost Boys' feast.
S: Melon, kiwi, pineapple and blueberries in rainbow rows, lime and honey drizzle
Watermelon, rockmelon, kiwi, pineapple and berries cut into chunks and arranged in rainbow rows, with a lime and honey drizzle.
the Lost Boys' feast and the food fight with Rufio

Three bright dips, beetroot hummus, pea and mint, and carrot with cumin, swirled in bowls with warm pita chips for flicking at the table. Blitz 1 drained 400g tin chickpeas with 2 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and 3 tbsp oil, then split in two. Blend one half with 1 cooked beetroot. Blend 200g frozen peas, cooked, with mint, 50g feta and lemon. Boil 3 carrots until soft and blend with 1 tsp cumin, honey and oil. Cut 3 pitas into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 180C for 8 minutes.
Buttered white bread covered in hundreds and thousands, cut into triangles
White bread spread right to the edges with soft butter, pressed into hundreds and thousands, a dusting of edible glitter, cut into triangles.
M: Lost Boys roast chicken, potatoes and corn
Spatchcock chicken with garlic, lemon and smoked paprika, potatoes, grilled corn
Whole chickens spatchcocked, rubbed with garlic, lemon and paprika, roasted at 220C for 45 minutes, with corn on the cob and roast potatoes, eaten with your hands.
aboard the Jolly Roger with Smee

Beef chuck braised three hours with smoky paprika, tomato, carrot and molasses until sticky and dark, served with cheesy ship's biscuit damper. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Cook 2 onions and 2 carrots 5 minutes, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp molasses, 400g tinned tomatoes and 600ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Rub 50g butter into 300g self-raising flour, add 80g cheddar and 200ml milk, shape into 8 rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: Pandan sponge with pandan buttercream and a chocolate clock face piped on top
Pandan sponge tinted green, baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in green buttercream with a chocolate clock face on top.
K: Lemonade with lime juice and a pinch of edible glitter
Lemonade with a squeeze of lime, a pinch of edible glitter swirled in so it shimmers.

lines: Granny Wendy's, please be on time

steps.text: Cut the watermelon, rockmelon, kiwifruit and pineapple into chunks.
Arrange in rainbow rows with the blueberries.
Drizzle with lime juice mixed with honey.
Spread the bread with butter right to the edges.
Press face down into the hundreds and thousands and dust with edible glitter.
Trim the crusts and cut into triangles.

dishes.n: Lost Boys roast chicken, potatoes and corn

steps.text: Spatchcock the chicken and rub with crushed garlic, lemon zest and paprika. Chop the potatoes.
Roast at 220C with the potatoes in the tray.
Grill the corn cobs, turning until charred.
Pile it all in the middle and eat with your hands. Bangarang.

veg.n: Lost Boys roast haloumi, potatoes and corn

steps.text: Mix the crushed garlic, lemon zest, paprika and oil. Chop the potatoes and toss in half of it.
Roast the potatoes at 220C.
Toss the haloumi in the rest of the garlic mix, add to the tray and roast until golden.
Grill the corn cobs, turning until charred.
Pile it all in the middle with a squeeze of the lemon and eat with your hands. Bangarang.
Whisk the eggs with the sugar until thick, then fold in the flour, 60g melted butter and half the pandan.
Bake in a lined tin at 175C.
Cool the cake.
Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and rest of the pandan, then cover the cake.
Pipe a clock face with melted dark chocolate.
Pour the cold lemonade into a jug with the lime juice.
Stir in the glitter and pour into four glasses straight away.

s.note: Melon, kiwi, pineapple and blueberries in rainbow rows, lime and honey drizzle
s.how: Cut a quarter watermelon, a quarter rockmelon, 2 kiwifruit and a quarter pineapple into chunks. Arrange in rainbow rows with 125g blueberries. Drizzle with the juice of a lime mixed with honey.

s.note: Buttered white bread covered in hundreds and thousands, cut into triangles
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with soft butter right to the edges. Press face down into hundreds and thousands, then dust with a little edible glitter. Trim the crusts and cut into triangles.

m.n: Lost Boys roast chicken, potatoes and corn
m.note: Spatchcock chicken with garlic, lemon and smoked paprika, potatoes, grilled corn
m.how: Spatchcock a 1.8kg chicken and rub with 3 garlic cloves, lemon zest and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Roast at 220C for 45 minutes with 800g potatoes. Grill 4 corn cobs. Pile it all in the middle and eat with your hands. Bangarang.

w.note: Pandan sponge with pandan buttercream and a chocolate clock face piped on top
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, then fold in 150g self-raising flour, 60g melted butter and 1 tsp pandan extract. Bake at 175C for 30 minutes. Cover in 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar and pandan. Pipe a clock face in 50g melted dark chocolate.

d.note: Lemonade with lime juice and a pinch of edible glitter
d.how: Pour 1.25L cold lemonade into a jug with the juice of a lime. Stir in a pinch of edible glitter so it shimmers and swirls. Pour into four glasses straight away.
